newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares rose in best turnover this month.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares rose in best turnover this month.

text.p: Egyptian share prices edged higher and cement shares saw solid trade on Monday in the bourse's highest turnover in nearly a month.
The Capital Market Authority overall index closed 0.33 points higher at 337.5 in trade of 76.3 million pounds ($22.5 million), its highest level since July 21.
Most of the heavily traded shares were pushed up less than a pound at the close of the day's trade.
Suez Cement saw 7.2 million pounds worth of trade. Its share closed up 0.53 at 64.44.
"Suez is one of the shares which has been trading heavy volumes. It's one of the GDR shares where there was a spread between the GDR and the local price," said a broker.
Amriyah Cement turnover was 1.8 million pounds. Its share price also rose a fraction, ending up 0.1 to 80.24.
Another which showed high turnover was in chemicals.
Abu Qir Fertilisers and Chemical Industries shares rose 0.83 to 74.66 in turnover worth 1.9 million pounds.
Paints and Chemical Industries/PACHIN was up 1.5 pounds to 119.5 in trade worth 1.7 million.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 462.71 points from 460.47 points on Sunday and that for the rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 249.47 from 249.71.
Of the 86 shares traded, 41 rose, 30 ended lower and 15 remained unchanged.
